name: Call Me
description:
Call Me phones your verified number the moment an AI task finishes or gets blocked. It reads the update aloud, asks its questions, and captures your spoken reply — so you can direct the next step hands-free, without touching your desk. Built for founders, executives, consultants, salespeople, and anyone who runs their day on the go.

How it works: verify your phone once, then tell Claude "call me when this is done." When it finishes (or hits a wall), your phone rings, the assistant reads what it did or where it's stuck, and you just talk back. Pro adds full back-and-forth conversations.

Two tools: call_me (places a call with your summary, next steps, and questions, then captures your spoken reply) and get_call_result (fetches a call's status and transcript). It only ever rings your own verified number.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Call Me to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Call Me to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://getcallme.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Call Me MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call Me provides these MCP tools: call_me and get_call_result.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Call Me?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Call Me in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Call Me MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call Me requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Call Me is developed by Call Me. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
